text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: An Emperor's absolute perfection is not an easy ideal to live up to.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: At times, I'm blinded by the sheer brilliance of my ideals…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But even if it is nigh impossible, I do not wish to settle for anything less.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I beg you, Trainer. I will endure any labor you propose.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Train me until I can bear this burden!
choice_data_list: Let's take it one step at a time.
Time for the workout of a lifetime!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No. I'll never attain perfection by letting my emotions get the better of me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer. I've regained my composure.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Yet again, you've taught me a valuable lesson.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ha, I would expect nothing less. There's no need to hold back.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: If I wish to preach, I must be willing to practice!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: My victory must be absolute! My prowess beyond question!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I am Symboli Rudolf, the Emperor—and when I next take to the track, I will live up to that name!
